import datetime as dt
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import sys
import time
import uuid
sys.path.insert(0, '/home/r/dev/minor/stackd/scripts/aws')
from aws_cli import observe

DEST = Path('/home/r/dev/minor/stackd/testdata/aws/sns/encryption_equivalent_sessions.json')
REGION, ACCOUNT = 'us-east-1', '000000000000'
PREFIX = 'stackd-sns-equivalent-' + uuid.uuid4().hex[:10]
BASE = dict(os.environ, AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=REGION, AWS_REGION=REGION, AWS_PAGER='', AWS_MAX_ATTEMPTS='2')
START = time.time()
OWN = dict(topics=[], subscriptions=[], queue=None, key=None, role=None)
DATA = dict(account=ACCOUNT, region=REGION, prefix=PREFIX, started=START, observations=[], receipts=[], windows=[], crypto_events=[], cleanup=[], sessions={}, owned_resources=OWN,
    source_revisions={'stackd':'3607cc0ab878a09119cdf25412a4c8b28d21ece0'},
    source_links=['https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-key-management.html','https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/ct-generatedatakey.html','https://docs.aws.amazon.com/STS/latest/APIReference/API_AssumeRole.html'],
    limits=['One disposable role and CMK in one account/region; no fleet-wide sharing or TTL claim.', 'Identical policy means byte-identical Policy inputs within the explicit-session-policy cohort, not equivalence to the no-policy cohort.', 'No cold decision is inferred solely from elapsed time. Actual failed KMS request IDs and fresh topic encryption contexts are retained.', 'CloudTrail is eventual; its capture deadline is bounded and missing events remain missing evidence.'],
    redaction_note='Issued STS credential components have stable per-session labels. Other AWS access-key IDs (including SNS forward-access credentials) have distinct UNISSUED_ACCESS_KEY labels and are not attributed to the caller credential. Caller annotations are experiment routing metadata, not AWS response fields.')
SECRETS, UNKNOWN_KEYS, ENVS = {}, {}, {}

def now():
    return dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc).isoformat()

def save():
    DATA['updated'] = now()
    text = json.dumps(DATA, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
    for raw, replacement in SECRETS.items():
        text = text.replace(raw, replacement)
    def unknown(match):
        raw = match.group()
        if raw not in UNKNOWN_KEYS:
            UNKNOWN_KEYS[raw] = '<UNISSUED_ACCESS_KEY_' + str(len(UNKNOWN_KEYS)+1) + '>'
        return UNKNOWN_KEYS[raw]
    text = re.sub(r'\b(?:AKIA|ASIA)[A-Z0-9]{16}\b', unknown, text)
    DEST.write_text(text + '\n')

def call(label, service, operation, params=None, session=None, strict=True, cleanup=False):
    begin = now()
    result = observe(service, operation, params or {}, ENVS[session] if session else BASE)
    row = dict(label=label, service=service, operation=operation, input=params or {}, result=result, started=begin, observed=now())
    if session:
        row.update(caller_session=session, caller_access_key=ENVS[session]['AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID'])
    DATA['cleanup' if cleanup else 'observations'].append(row)
    save()
    if strict and result['code'] != 'Success':
        raise RuntimeError(label + ':' + result['code'])
    return result

def out(label, service, operation, params=None, session=None):
    return call(label,service,operation,params,session)['output']

def assume(label, arn, name, policy=None):
    params = dict(RoleArn=arn, RoleSessionName=name, DurationSeconds=1800)
    if policy is not None:
        params['Policy'] = policy
    for attempt in range(12):
        begin = now()
        result = observe('sts','assume-role',params,BASE)
        if result['code'] == 'Success':
            credentials = result['output']['Credentials']
            for field in ('AccessKeyId','SecretAccessKey','SessionToken'):
                SECRETS[credentials[field]] = '<' + label.upper().replace('-','_') + '_' + field.upper() + '>'
        DATA['observations'].append(dict(label='assume-'+label+'-'+str(attempt),service='sts',operation='assume-role',input=params,result=result,started=begin,observed=now()))
        save()
        if result['code'] == 'Success':
            ENVS[label] = dict(BASE, AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=credentials['AccessKeyId'], AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=credentials['SecretAccessKey'], AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=credentials['SessionToken'])
            DATA['sessions'][label] = dict(role_arn=arn,session_name=name,access_key=credentials['AccessKeyId'],assumed_role=result['output']['AssumedRoleUser'],expiration=credentials['Expiration'],policy_sha256=hashlib.sha256(policy.encode()).hexdigest() if policy else None)
            DATA['sessions'][label]['identity'] = out('identity-'+label,'sts','get-caller-identity',session=label)
            save()
            return
        if result['code'] != 'AccessDenied':
            raise RuntimeError('AssumeRole:' + result['code'])
        time.sleep(5)
    raise RuntimeError('Role propagation deadline')

def collect(label, seconds=6):
    begin, deadline, matches = now(), time.monotonic()+seconds, []
    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
        result = call('receive-'+label,'sqs','receive-message',dict(QueueUrl=OWN['queue'],MaxNumberOfMessages=10,WaitTimeSeconds=1,MessageSystemAttributeNames=['All']))
        for message in result['output'].get('Messages',[]):
            try:
                body = json.loads(message['Body'])
            except (ValueError,KeyError):
                body = {}
            actual = body.get('label') if body.get('probe') == PREFIX else None
            DATA['receipts'].append(dict(collection_label=label,correlated_label=actual,observed=now(),message=message))
            if actual == label:
                matches.append(message['MessageId'])
            call('delete-receipt-'+label,'sqs','delete-message',dict(QueueUrl=OWN['queue'],ReceiptHandle=message['ReceiptHandle']))
    DATA['windows'].append(dict(label=label,started=begin,finished=now(),matching_sqs_message_ids=matches,requested_seconds=seconds))
    save()
    return matches

def publish(label, topic, session):
    result = call(label,'sns','publish',dict(TopicArn=topic,Message=json.dumps(dict(probe=PREFIX,label=label),sort_keys=True)),session,strict=False)
    matches = collect(label)
    print(json.dumps(dict(label=label,code=result['code'],receipts=len(matches))),flush=True)
    return result['code'], bool(matches)

def create_topic(suffix, queue_arn):
    topic = out('create-'+suffix,'sns','create-topic',dict(Name=PREFIX+'-'+suffix,Attributes={'KmsMasterKeyId':OWN['key']['Arn']}))['TopicArn']
    OWN['topics'].append(topic)
    save()
    sub = out('subscribe-'+suffix,'sns','subscribe',dict(TopicArn=topic,Protocol='sqs',Endpoint=queue_arn,Attributes={'RawMessageDelivery':'true'}))['SubscriptionArn']
    OWN['subscriptions'].append(sub)
    save()
    return topic

def capture_crypto(label):
    for operation in ('GenerateDataKey','Decrypt'):
        params = dict(LookupAttributes=[dict(AttributeKey='EventName',AttributeValue=operation)],StartTime=dt.datetime.fromtimestamp(START-10,dt.timezone.utc).isoformat(),EndTime=DATA['experiment_finished'],MaxResults=50)
        begin = now()
        result = observe('cloudtrail','lookup-events',params,BASE)
        if result['code'] == 'Success':
            result['output']['Events'] = [event for event in result['output'].get('Events',[]) if OWN['key']['KeyId'] in event.get('CloudTrailEvent','')]
            events = [json.loads(event['CloudTrailEvent']) for event in result['output']['Events']]
            DATA['crypto_events'] = list({event['eventID']:event for event in DATA['crypto_events']+events}.values())
        DATA['observations'].append(dict(label=label+'-'+operation,service='cloudtrail',operation='lookup-events',input=params,result=result,started=begin,observed=now(),filter='Only events containing exact owned CMK UUID retained; unrelated events discarded.'))
        save()
    failures = {re.search(r'Request ID: ([0-9a-f-]+)',row['result'].get('error',{}).get('Message','')).group(1) for row in DATA['observations'] if row['service']=='sns' and row['operation']=='publish' and re.search(r'Request ID: ([0-9a-f-]+)',row['result'].get('error',{}).get('Message',''))}
    captured = {event.get('requestID') for event in DATA['crypto_events']}
    DATA['cloudtrail_missing_publish_failure_request_ids'] = sorted(failures-captured)
    save()
    return not (failures-captured)

try:
    identity = out('verify-account-before-mutation','sts','get-caller-identity')
    assert identity['Account'] == ACCOUNT, 'Wrong account; refuse mutations'
    OWN['key'] = out('create-owned-key','kms','create-key',dict(Description=PREFIX))['KeyMetadata']
    out('record-original-key-policy','kms','get-key-policy',dict(KeyId=OWN['key']['Arn'],PolicyName='default'))
    OWN['queue'] = out('create-collector','sqs','create-queue',dict(QueueName=PREFIX,Attributes={'SqsManagedSseEnabled':'false','MessageRetentionPeriod':'3600'}))['QueueUrl']
    queue_arn = out('collector-arn','sqs','get-queue-attributes',dict(QueueUrl=OWN['queue'],AttributeNames=['QueueArn']))['Attributes']['QueueArn']
    topic_pattern = 'arn:aws:sns:'+REGION+':'+ACCOUNT+':'+PREFIX+'-*'
    queue_policy = dict(Version='2012-10-17',Statement=[dict(Effect='Allow',Principal={'Service':'sns.amazonaws.com'},Action='sqs:SendMessage',Resource=queue_arn,Condition={'ArnLike':{'aws:SourceArn':topic_pattern}})])
    out('authorize-owned-topics-only','sqs','set-queue-attributes',dict(QueueUrl=OWN['queue'],Attributes={'Policy':json.dumps(queue_policy)}))
    trust = dict(Version='2012-10-17',Statement=[dict(Effect='Allow',Principal={'AWS':identity['Arn']},Action='sts:AssumeRole')])
    role = out('create-owned-role','iam','create-role',dict(RoleName=PREFIX,AssumeRolePolicyDocument=json.dumps(trust)))['Role']
    OWN['role'] = role['RoleName']
    policy = json.dumps(dict(Version='2012-10-17',Statement=[dict(Effect='Allow',Action='sns:Publish',Resource=topic_pattern),dict(Effect='Allow',Action=['kms:GenerateDataKey','kms:Decrypt'],Resource=OWN['key']['Arn'])]),separators=(',',':'))
    DATA['identical_allowing_session_policy'] = policy
    out('authorize-owned-role','iam','put-role-policy',dict(RoleName=OWN['role'],PolicyName='publication',PolicyDocument=policy))
    topics = {cohort:create_topic(cohort+'-baseline',queue_arn) for cohort in ('no-policy','allow-policy')}
    for cohort in topics:
        for variant in ('original','same-name-new','different-name-new'):
            assume(cohort+'-'+variant,role['Arn'],'baseline' if variant!='different-name-new' else 'different',policy if cohort=='allow-policy' else None)
    assert len({env['AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID'] for env in ENVS.values()}) == 6
    time.sleep(10)
    DATA['comparison_runs'] = []
    for run in range(2):
        if run:
            out('reenable-for-bounded-fresh-run','kms','enable-key',dict(KeyId=OWN['key']['Arn']))
            assert out('confirm-enabled-fresh-run','kms','describe-key',dict(KeyId=OWN['key']['Arn']))['KeyMetadata']['KeyState']=='Enabled'
            topics = {cohort:create_topic(cohort+'-rerun',queue_arn) for cohort in topics}
        run_result = dict(run=run,topics=topics,baseline={},disabled={})
        DATA['comparison_runs'].append(run_result)
        for cohort,topic in topics.items():
            result = publish('run'+str(run)+'-'+cohort+'-baseline',topic,cohort+'-original')
            run_result['baseline'][cohort] = result
            assert result == ('Success',True), 'Baseline lacks successful receipt'
        out('disable-key-run'+str(run),'kms','disable-key',dict(KeyId=OWN['key']['Arn']))
        assert out('confirm-disabled-run'+str(run),'kms','describe-key',dict(KeyId=OWN['key']['Arn']))['KeyMetadata']['KeyState']=='Disabled'
        call('disabled-data-plane-control-run'+str(run),'kms','generate-data-key',dict(KeyId=OWN['key']['Arn'],KeySpec='AES_256',EncryptionContext={'probe':PREFIX}),strict=False)
        for cohort,topic in topics.items():
            run_result['disabled'][cohort] = {}
            for variant in ('original-before','same-name-new','different-name-new','original-after'):
                session = cohort+('-original' if variant.startswith('original') else '-'+variant)
                run_result['disabled'][cohort][variant] = publish('run'+str(run)+'-'+cohort+'-disabled-'+variant,topic,session)
        save()
        if all(any(result==('Success',True) for name,result in cases.items() if name.startswith('original')) for cases in run_result['disabled'].values()):
            break
    out('enable-for-valid-permission-controls','kms','enable-key',dict(KeyId=OWN['key']['Arn']))
    assert out('confirm-enabled-controls','kms','describe-key',dict(KeyId=OWN['key']['Arn']))['KeyMetadata']['KeyState']=='Enabled'
    DATA['fresh_context_controls'] = {}
    for session in ENVS:
        topic = create_topic('control-'+session,queue_arn)
        DATA['fresh_context_controls'][session] = dict(topic=topic,result=publish('enabled-fresh-'+session,topic,session))
    DATA['experiment_finished'] = now()
    DATA['cloudtrail_deadline'] = (dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc)+dt.timedelta(seconds=420)).isoformat()
    deadline = time.monotonic()+420
    for attempt in range(8):
        complete = capture_crypto('crypto-'+str(attempt))
        contexts = {event.get('requestParameters',{}).get('encryptionContext',{}).get('aws:sns:topicArn') for event in DATA['crypto_events'] if isinstance(event.get('requestParameters'),dict)}
        if complete and all(control['topic'] in contexts for control in DATA['fresh_context_controls'].values()):
            break
        if time.monotonic()+60 > deadline:
            break
        time.sleep(60)
except BaseException as error:
    DATA['failure'] = type(error).__name__+':'+str(error)
    save()
finally:
    DATA['source'] = Path(__file__).read_text()
    for sub in OWN['subscriptions']:
        call('unsubscribe-owned','sns','unsubscribe',dict(SubscriptionArn=sub),strict=False,cleanup=True)
        call('confirm-subscription-absent','sns','get-subscription-attributes',dict(SubscriptionArn=sub),strict=False,cleanup=True)
    for topic in OWN['topics']:
        call('delete-owned-topic','sns','delete-topic',dict(TopicArn=topic),strict=False,cleanup=True)
        call('confirm-topic-absent','sns','get-topic-attributes',dict(TopicArn=topic),strict=False,cleanup=True)
    if OWN['queue']:
        call('delete-owned-collector','sqs','delete-queue',dict(QueueUrl=OWN['queue']),strict=False,cleanup=True)
        call('confirm-collector-absent','sqs','get-queue-attributes',dict(QueueUrl=OWN['queue'],AttributeNames=['QueueArn']),strict=False,cleanup=True)
    if OWN['role']:
        call('delete-owned-inline-policy','iam','delete-role-policy',dict(RoleName=OWN['role'],PolicyName='publication'),strict=False,cleanup=True)
        call('confirm-inline-policy-absent','iam','get-role-policy',dict(RoleName=OWN['role'],PolicyName='publication'),strict=False,cleanup=True)
        call('delete-owned-role','iam','delete-role',dict(RoleName=OWN['role']),strict=False,cleanup=True)
        call('confirm-role-absent','iam','get-role',dict(RoleName=OWN['role']),strict=False,cleanup=True)
    if OWN['key']:
        call('schedule-owned-key-deletion','kms','schedule-key-deletion',dict(KeyId=OWN['key']['Arn'],PendingWindowInDays=7),strict=False,cleanup=True)
        call('confirm-key-pending-deletion','kms','describe-key',dict(KeyId=OWN['key']['Arn']),strict=False,cleanup=True)
    DATA['finished'] = now()
    save()
    print(json.dumps(dict(finished=DATA['finished'],failure=DATA.get('failure'),prefix=PREFIX,receipts=len(DATA['receipts']),crypto_events=len(DATA['crypto_events']))),flush=True)
